title.justification: This is the title of the paper.

extractions.description: This paper introduces the Resource-Efficient Separation Transformer (RE-SepFormer) for speech separation, which reduces computational cost using non-overlapping blocks in the latent space and compact latent summaries. It achieves competitive performance on WSJ0-2Mix and WHAM! datasets with significantly reduced memory and inference time.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on efficient deep learning techniques for speech separation, with a mention of reducing CO2 emissions as a consequence of using less energy, but it is not a central theme.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Large neural models, however, are energy-demanding, causing high inference costs (with considerable CO2 emissions [6]) that limit their widespread adoption in production systems.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus is on speech separation, not directly related to climate change or ecological sustainability.
primary_category.quote: This paper explores Transformer-based speech separation with a reduced computational cost.
